svg.title: Evidence-grounded ontology evolution
svg.desc: Three-stage architecture: immutable source preparation, bounded agentic ontology and mapping revision, then sealed evaluation and explicit human review. Production profile integration is not implemented in this experiment.
svg.text: Implemented experimental architecture for onboarding unfamiliar business datasets
Discovery evidence enters planning; test rows stay withheld
Targeted revision: affected ontology and/or mapping only
CONTROL: per-source budgets | at most 3 attempts per group | stop unchanged failures | reuse accepted groups
Accepted groups retained; unresolved groups reported
(c) Candidate assembly, evaluation and human review
AUDIT: frozen rows + partitions / recorded model decisions / hashes + token ledger / sealed evidence + offline replay
Production integration: not implemented in this experiment
Resolve role-to-business identity and graph semantics before merging candidate facts into the existing company profiles.
